headline: Presentations by four Maine educational organizations on their policy priorities for the upcoming state legislative session.
summary: Representatives from four Maine educational organizations will present their policy priorities for the upcoming state legislative session. A discussion and question-and-answer period will follow.
items: Policy priorities of Maine educational organizations for the upcoming state legislative session
plain_text:
Public and Legislative Affairs Committee Meeting Agenda 
Monday, November 2, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
Remote Only [https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84060258850] 
 
 
1. Welcome   
1.1 Welcome and agenda review  
1.2 Public Comment  
2. Business Items   
2.1 Policy Priorities of Educational Organizations in Maine: Representatives from four 
Maine educational organizations will present their policy priorities for the upcoming state 
legislative session, including the issues they plan to advocate for before the Maine 
Legislature. A discussion and question-and-answer period will follow. 
Panelists: 
Dana Brown, President, NASW-Maine (National Association of Social Workers) 
Robbie Feinberg, Director of Communications and Government Relations, Maine School 
Board Association (MSBA)  
Rita Furlow, Senior Policy Analyst, Maine Children’s Alliance 
Jesse Hargrove, President, Maine Educational Association (MEA) 
 
3. Adjournment   
3.1 Vote to adjourn the Public and Legislative Affairs Committee Meeting  
4. Upcoming Meetings   
4.1 Next Meeting is on Monday, November 16
